messages:
Iris (CSM): Heads-up: HarborView dropped to ~10% of PoC traffic after handoff. Noticed the cliff Friday afternoon. Anyone digging in?
Dan (AE): I saw it in the account dashboard. Carmen (new ML lead) was added last week; procurement mentioned theyre running an eval with EchoStack this week.
Mika (Solutions Eng): Any infra or model swaps on our side around the drop window?
Iris (CSM): No config flips from CSM. Quick query I ran: ```SELECT day, sum(requests) FROM api_calls WHERE account='harborview' AND day >= '2025-11-10' GROUP BY day;``` shows near-zero after 2025-11-21.
billing-bot: invoice HVW-2025-11 generated 2025-11-22 status: unpaid. Reminder queued.
Carmen (HarborView): Hey team  we've paused traffic while we validate cost for long-document folding. EchoStack demo showed a prefetch/prune flow that looked cheaper in their tests. Also security wants a VPC/KMS diagram.
Theo (HarborView): and a simple token-cost comparison table would help procurement.
Dan (AE): Plan: prep VPC/KMS doc + SOC2 checklist, run token-cost sim vs EchoStack, and propose a short no-charge 5-day dedicated trial with prefetch/KV enabled.
Mika (Solutions Eng): Mitigation: enable prefix KV for top templates, enable prefetch for repeated prefixes, and add adaptive chunking for >15k token inputs. Expect ~25% token reduction in typical workloads. I'll prepare a before/after token report.
Iris (CSM): Draft outreach: "Carmen/Theo  we can send the security pack today and run a 5-day dedicated trial (no charge) with prefetch + KV caching so you can compare real results vs EchoStack. Can we schedule 30m tomorrow to align?"
Carmen (HarborView): That would be helpful. Please send VPC/KMS and SOC2 checklist first so our security team can review. Fri morning works for a call.
Iris (CSM): Action items: Iris -> send security pack + schedule call; Mika -> perf sim + KV config; Dan -> competitive cost slide and trial terms. I'll follow up if there's any more silence before Fri. :eyes:
